title: Trusted SourceRef Bridge: metadata rows stop replacing review proof

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.65 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow package-export bridge repair; focused package/source coverage plus normal local gates and gold smoke are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is driven by source-ledger bridge evidence and local regressions; another deployed provider audit is required after deploy.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: The package sourceRef bridge now uses the same strict trusted-row predicate as source summaries and deep-quality source checks.
CourseIR sourceRef coverage only bridges when more than one accessible, non-ambiguous, trust-eligible source row exists.
Metadata-only source rows remain exported for review without replacing CourseIR review proof or inflating sourceRef coverage.
A package-export regression pins the metadata-only failure mode and keeps Source Review Notes visible until trusted concept-linked proof exists.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh EduTool.dev ZIP/log audit and verify trusted, concept-linked source rows reach package source proof.
If source points remain below target, inspect retrieval failure, source-finder attachment loss during repair, or insufficient trusted rows.
Improve slide-deck substance and deterministic texture variation until a fresh package honestly reaches 100/100.
